fields.name: meeting_type
fields.description: Vote data is captured for the following meetings types: Council; Special Council; Policy & Strategic Priorities; City Finance & Services and Public Hearing
fields.label: Meeting Type

fields.name: vote_date
fields.description: The date that the vote was recorded
fields.label: Vote Date

fields.name: vote_number
fields.description:
A unique vote number which identifies an agenda item for consideration by vote. This number is also referenced in the corresponding meeting minutes.
Note: This field will not appear in sequence due to removal of test and error votes. Consent agenda item votes are recorded after the meeting and will therefore not appear in sequence.
fields.label: Vote Number

fields.name: agenda_description
fields.description:
The agenda item title which is noted in the minutes of the meeting. 

Note: The following vote types are excluded from the vote data:

* Adoption of Minutes
* Matters Adopted on Consent
* Resolution to move into/rise from Committee of the Whole
* Adopt Report of Committee of the Whole or Standing Committee
* Bylaws adopted by blanket motion
* Administrative Motions adopted by blanket motion
* Motion to hold an In Camera Meeting

Where an item is referred to another meeting or back to staff, the vote is noted as referred in this field.
fields.label: Agenda Description

fields.name: vote_start_date_time
fields.description: The date and time that the vote was called at the meeting.
fields.label: Vote Start Date Time

fields.name: council_member
fields.description: The name of the Council member conducting the vote.
fields.label: Council Member

fields.name: vote
fields.description:
A Council member's response on a motion. Votes are recorded as follows:
In Favour: In favour of the motion.
In Opposition: In opposition of the motion.
Absent: Absent from the current meeting or absent from the Council Chambers, but present at the meeting.
Abstain: Formally decline to vote (recorded as a vote in favour of the motion pursuant to s. 145.1(3) of the Vancouver Charter).
Declared Conflict: Conflict of Interest declared pursuant to s.145.2 of the Vancouver Charter.
No Vote: Vacant Council seat
Ineligible: Not eligible to vote (on a Public Hearing item due to absence from the Public Hearing) 
Note: For voting records captured before September 21 2021, No Vote was defined as “Not eligible to vote (on a Public Hearing item due to absence from the Public Hearing) or vacant Council seat”
fields.label: Vote

fields.name: decision
fields.description:
The outcome of the vote. 
Carried Unanimously: A motion that is passed by the affirmative vote of all Council members present at the meeting. Note: Some agenda items with this decision type may have been adopted on consent.
Carried: A motion that is passed by the affirmative vote of the majority or two-thirds of the Council members present at the meeting, depending on the requirements for a motion.
Lost: A motion that is defeated by the negative vote of the majority of Council members present at the meeting.
fields.label: Decision

fields.name: vote_detail_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for each data row.
fields.label: Vote Detail Id

default.title: Council voting records
default.description:
The posting of voting records for City of Vancouver Council members is part of the City's ongoing commitment to open, transparent and proactive disclosure of data. In 2016, City Council began using an electronic voting system which has enabled the City to capture individual Council member vote records for Council, Special Council, Standing Committee, Public Hearing, Courts of Revision, and Auditor General Committee meeting types.

Note: 

  • Please consult corresponding meeting minutes for official vote records.
  • On September 21, 2021, Vote attribute definition for No Vote was updated to improve clarity. See change log on this date for details.​​

Data currency

The voting records extract is updated following Council, Special Council, Standing Committees, Public Hearing, Courts of Revision, and Auditor General Committee meetings. The most recent data will be available within two business days of the meeting minutes being published.

Note: 

  • ​​Following complex meetings with a large number of agenda items, data release may be delayed by several business days.
  • On November 26, 2019, Council approved the changes to the Procedure By-law included updating the meeting name of Regular Council to Council in effort to modernize the name and make it more meaningful to citizens.

Data accuracy

  • Erroneous and test votes are not included in the data sets, therefore vote numbers will not appear in sequence.
  • Consent agenda item votes are recorded after the meeting and will therefore not appear in sequence.
